ruleDefinitions.name: AADInternals PowerShell Cmdlets Execution - PsScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects ADDInternals Cmdlet execution. A tool for administering Azure AD and Office 365. Which can be abused by threat actors to attack Azure AD or Office 365. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Add\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*ConvertTo\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Disable\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Enable\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Export\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Find\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Get\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Grant\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Initialize\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Install\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Join\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*New\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Open\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Read\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Register\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Remove\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Reset\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Resolve\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Restore\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Save\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Search\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Send\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Start\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Unprotect\\-AADInt.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Update\\-AADInt.*"))
